name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: 0.0.213: Linked servers. Two servers of your own that are friends can be linked from Friends → Manage → Link: click Link on both and type each server's six-digit code on the other. Linked servers then use each other's friends as their own, with nothing for those friends to do: to them both servers are the same server. Settings stay separate. Only link servers you own: whoever runs either server can act as the other towards its friends.
